contacts_primary_customer_unique.name: contacts_primary_customer_unique
contacts_primary_customer_unique.where: "contacts"."is_primary" = true and "contacts"."active" = true and "contacts"."customer_id" is not null

contacts_primary_company_unique.name: contacts_primary_company_unique
contacts_primary_company_unique.where: "contacts"."is_primary" = true and "contacts"."active" = true and "contacts"."company_id" is not null

contacts_parent_required.name: contacts_parent_required
contacts_parent_required.value: "contacts"."customer_id" is not null or "contacts"."company_id" is not null

leads_conversion_complete.name: leads_conversion_complete
leads_conversion_complete.value: ("leads"."converted_customer_id" is null and "leads"."converted_at" is null and "leads"."converted_by" is null) or ("leads"."converted_customer_id" is not null and "leads"."converted_at" is not null and "leads"."converted_by" is not null and "leads"."status" = 'won')

deals_lost_reason_complete.name: deals_lost_reason_complete
deals_lost_reason_complete.value: "deals"."lost_reason" is null or "deals"."closed_at" is not null

tasks_completion_consistent.name: tasks_completion_consistent
tasks_completion_consistent.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' and "tasks"."completed_at" is not null) or ("tasks"."status" <> 'completed' and "tasks"."completed_at" is null)

attachments_storage_delete_requires_arch.name: attachments_storage_delete_requires_archive
attachments_storage_delete_requires_arch.value: "attachments"."storage_deleted_at" is null or "attachments"."archived_at" is not null

job_checklist_completion_consistent.name: job_checklist_completion_consistent
job_checklist_completion_consistent.value: ("job_checklist_items"."completed"=false and "job_checklist_items"."completed_at" is null) or ("job_checklist_items"."completed"=true and "job_checklist_items"."completed_at" is not null)

jobs_schedule_complete.name: jobs_schedule_complete
jobs_schedule_complete.value: ("jobs"."scheduled_date" is null and "jobs"."scheduled_time" is null) or ("jobs"."scheduled_date" is not null and "jobs"."scheduled_time" is not null)

invoices_live_job_unique.name: invoices_live_job_unique
invoices_live_job_unique.where: "invoices"."job_id" is not null and "invoices"."status" <> 'void' and "invoices"."archived_at" is null

invoices_live_contract_unique.name: invoices_live_contract_unique
invoices_live_contract_unique.where: "invoices"."contract_id" is not null and "invoices"."status" <> 'void' and "invoices"."archived_at" is null

invoice_source_integrity.name: invoice_source_integrity
invoice_source_integrity.value: ("invoices"."source"='manual' and "invoices"."job_id" is null and "invoices"."contract_id" is null and "invoices"."contract_version_id" is null and "invoices"."quote_id" is null and "invoices"."quote_version_id" is null and "invoices"."quote_option_id" is null) or ("invoices"."source"='job' and "invoices"."job_id" is not null and "invoices"."contract_id" is null and "invoices"."contract_version_id" is null and "invoices"."quote_id" is null and "invoices"."quote_version_id" is null and "invoices"."quote_option_id" is null) or ("invoices"."source"='contract' and "invoices"."job_id" is null and "invoices"."contract_id" is not null and "invoices"."contract_version_id" is not null and "invoices"."quote_id" is not null and "invoices"."quote_version_id" is not null and "invoices"."quote_option_id" is not null)

invoice_issue_dates_consistent.name: invoice_issue_dates_consistent
invoice_issue_dates_consistent.value: ("invoices"."status"='draft' and "invoices"."issued_at" is null) or "invoices"."status"='void' or ("invoices"."status" in ('issued','partially_paid','paid') and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null)

payment_event_integrity.name: payment_event_integrity
payment_event_integrity.value: ("payments"."entry_type"='payment' and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is null and "payments"."reversal_reason" is null) or ("payments"."entry_type"='reversal' and "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null and length(trim("payments"."reversal_reason")) > 0)

maintenance_plan_money_valid.name: maintenance_plan_money_valid
maintenance_plan_money_valid.value: "maintenance_plans"."price_cents">=0 and ("maintenance_plans"."discount_fixed_cents" is null or "maintenance_plans"."discount_fixed_cents">=0) and ("maintenance_plans"."discount_basis_points" is null or ("maintenance_plans"."discount_basis_points">=0 and "maintenance_plans"."discount_basis_points"<=10000))

maintenance_schedule_interval_valid.name: maintenance_schedule_interval_valid
maintenance_schedule_interval_valid.value: ("maintenance_schedules"."recurrence"='custom_days' and "maintenance_schedules"."custom_interval_days" between 1 and 3650) or ("maintenance_schedules"."recurrence"<>'custom_days' and "maintenance_schedules"."custom_interval_days" is null)

maintenance_signature_completion_valid.name: maintenance_signature_completion_valid
maintenance_signature_completion_valid.value: ("maintenance_signature_requests"."status"<>'signed') or ("maintenance_signature_requests"."signed_at" is not null and "maintenance_signature_requests"."consent_at" is not null and "maintenance_signature_requests"."auto_renew_enabled" is not null)

maintenance_report_submission_valid.name: maintenance_report_submission_valid
maintenance_report_submission_valid.value: ("maintenance_service_reports"."status" = 'draft' and "maintenance_service_reports"."submitted_at" is null) or ("maintenance_service_reports"."status" = 'submitted' and "maintenance_service_reports"."submitted_at" is not null and "maintenance_service_reports"."customer_acknowledged_at" is not null and "maintenance_service_reports"."pre_work_attachment_id" is not null and "maintenance_service_reports"."post_work_attachment_id" is not null)

campaign_schedule_valid.name: campaign_schedule_valid
campaign_schedule_valid.value: "campaigns"."status"='draft' or "campaigns"."scheduled_for" is not null or "campaigns"."status" in ('cancelled','failed')

retention_preferences_consent_valid.name: retention_preferences_consent_valid
retention_preferences_consent_valid.value: (("retention_preferences"."marketing_email_opt_in"=false) or ("retention_preferences"."marketing_email_consent_at" is not null and length(trim("retention_preferences"."marketing_email_consent_source"))>0)) and (("retention_preferences"."marketing_sms_opt_in"=false) or ("retention_preferences"."marketing_sms_consent_at" is not null and length(trim("retention_preferences"."marketing_sms_consent_source"))>0))
